verdicts.decisive_quote: High; this is an explicit abstention after structured-output validation failure.
verdicts.verdict_one_line: A clean, well-labelled abstention whose 50/50 mass exactly matches its declared absence of evidence, but it cites nothing, names no driver of Alphabet revenue, contains no content that could not be pasted into any other question, and still emits contradictory tie-breaks ("prediction": "yes" in reasoning, "no" in forecast) after rating both intervals "unsupported".

verdicts.decisive_quote: Industry forecasts for 2025 global advertising revenue growth have been revised down to approximately 6%, which is below the target threshold of 12.04% for Alphabet's YoY revenue growth.
verdicts.verdict_one_line: Every figure it uses ($90.2B, YouTube 10.3%, ~6% ad-market forecast, $75B capex) is a real E1 item, it is the only trace to stress-test its carried-over structure and mark two of three inherited paths "CONTRADICTED" by current evidence, and its single quantitative anchor genuinely selects "no"; the reservations are that 0.7 is heavier than its own "insufficient" magnitude rating and "plausible" boundary check warrant, that it treats absence of support for yes as support for no, and that it applies an industry-aggregate 6% to a firm it has just described as outgrowing expectations.

ranking_rationale: The top of the field is separated by whether a quantity actually tethers the conclusion to the 12.04% boundary and whether the trace says the same thing twice: hgf and factor_memory both anchor on real percentages, and hgf alone carries one option consistently from reasoning to forecast while explicitly invalidating the structural priors it inherited. The bottom is occupied by traces that either conjure a decisive figure their bank never contained (principle_memory's 14.0% central, direct_forecast's 12.0%) or contribute no question-specific content whatsoever (structure_memory), with four of seven traces silently reversing between their stated reasoning prediction and their delivered forecast.
shared_evidence_note: Both causes are present but grounding dominates: the two E1 traces reasoned from concrete percentages (YouTube 10.3%, ~6% 2025 ad-market forecasts) that simply do not exist in E0, so the E0 traces were left arguing from headline sentiment and filling the numeric gap with invented central estimates that then drove opposite answers from near-identical premises.
